The consortium will build a national pool of geophysical instruments and multidisciplinary geophysical superstations in seismology, geomagnetism and geodesy. The present tender is about Broadband instrumentation for seismic observations. The present tender is about Broadband instrumentation for seismic observations. The tender is for 30 instruments, with an option to purchase 0-30 more, i.e., altogether up to 60 instruments. Each broadband instrument for seismic observations should consist of a digitizer and a separate three-component sensor pair, and must come with required cabling for full operation, including external GNSS antenna and open-ended cable for external DC power. System must support surface installations. System must be operable with a single power cable. Specifically, the sensor must be powered without an additional power cable. Digitizer must also support hot-swappable external memory storage card of at least 64 GB, i.e. data can be collected by changing the memory storage card in the field on the fly without interruption to data collection.
